name: Jan Procházka
bio:
Jan Procházka's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly. After earning a degree in journalism, he initially covered local rally events for a small Czech newspaper. The raw energy and passionate community captivated him, leading him to pivot his career towards motorsports full-time. He cut his teeth managing communications for a small European racing team, quickly demonstrating a talent for crafting compelling narratives and navigating media relations.

Jan's approach to PR is rooted in authenticity and transparency. He believes in fostering genuine connections with fans and media alike, building trust through open communication. He is adept at identifying and amplifying key messages, ensuring the team's story resonates with a global audience. His experience includes crisis communication, brand building, and developing social media strategies that drive engagement.

What sets Jan apart is his ability to anticipate trends and proactively shape the narrative. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and push boundaries, always seeking innovative ways to connect the team with its fans. His understanding of both the technical and human elements of motorsport makes him an invaluable asset to 23XI Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jan is a man of medium height with a slightly weathered face and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with observations and ideas.
Has a habit of pacing while on phone calls, often bumping into things.
Insists on brewing his own strong espresso every morning.
